description: Screen one hostname for DNS/IDN/punycode/TLS infrastructure naming risks: Unicode UTS #39 confusables and brand typosquatting. Static hostname analysis only; no DNS resolution or TLS certificate probe. Returns lookalike findings. Requires $0.002 Base USDC via x402. Use screen_impersonation for the 61-brand DeFi/AI handle corpus.
